trade.demo-mode-banner: Demo Mode - Trading on Bybit Demo with default demo account. Sign in to trade with your own account.
trade.last-button-tooltip: Sets form price to the last ticker price
trade.lastTradePriceTooltip: The most recent price at which a trade was executed
trade.markPriceTooltip: Fair price used for PnL and liquidation calculations
trade.price-alerts-settings-note: You can also open this panel by clicking the <bell /> bell icon on any chart module's tab header

trade.chat-show-trading-game-details: Show shared paper trading above chat on this device. Restore it here after hiding it.
trade.desktopUpdateRequired: Update the desktop app to use this.
trade.hardwareAccelerationDetails: Use hardware acceleration when available. Turn it off to troubleshoot graphics or TradingView sign-in problems. Changes require restarting the desktop app and affect all charts.
trade.hardwareAccelerationRestart: Restart Tealstreet to apply the hardware acceleration change.
trade.hardwareAccelerationFailed: Unable to read or save hardware acceleration settings. Try again.
trade.tradingViewSignInRetryFailed: Unable to reopen TradingView sign-in. Try again.
trade.desktopActivityDetails: Choose how the desktop app runs in the background and handles computer sleep.
trade.desktopActivityPassiveDetails: Allow background throttling while minimized. Computer sleep is allowed; reconnect on return.
trade.desktopActivityConnectedDetails: Keep connections and background work active while minimized. Computer sleep is allowed.
trade.desktopActivityPreventSleepDetails: Keep connections and background work active and prevent idle computer sleep. The screen can turn off. Uses more battery.
trade.desktopActivityWebhookDetails: Desktop webhook execution requires the app to be awake and connected. Forced sleep and shutdown still pause execution.
trade.desktopOnly: Only available in the desktop app.
trade.news-feed-open-in-panel: Show the news feed in the activity panel
trade.notificationMobilePushDetails: Phones signed in to the Tealstreet app with notifications on.
trade.notificationThrottleDetails: News notifications beyond this per minute stay in the activity panel without interrupting you. Also limits mobile push.
trade.notificationRulesSignIn: Sign in to manage notification rules.
trade.notificationRulesSearchTerms: fills price alerts news webhook runs mode
trade.notificationRuleTestBody: This is how this rule notifies you.
trade.notificationDesktopUnfocused: When the app is not focused
trade.notificationRuleNeedsChannel: Turn on a toast, desktop banner, sound or mobile push. The activity panel alone does not count; switch the rule off instead.
trade.notificationRuleNeedsCondition: A news rule that pushes to your phone needs a condition: impact, handle, keyword or symbol.
trade.notificationRuleGone: This rule was removed on another device.
trade.notificationRuleChangedElsewhere: This rule was changed on another device. Review it and try again.
trade.notificationRuleTooManyTerms: At most 50 handles, keywords or symbols per list.
trade.notificationRuleTermTooLong: Each handle, keyword or symbol is limited to 64 characters.
trade.notificationRuleBadConfidence: Minimum confidence must be a number from 0 to 1.
trade.notificationThrottleInvalid: Enter a whole number from 1 to 60.
trade.desktopNotificationsFailed: Desktop notifications could not be updated. Please try again.
trade.desktopNotificationsEnabledTest: Enabled. Test submitted; check Do Not Disturb if it is hidden.
trade.desktopNotificationsSubmitted: Test submitted; check Do Not Disturb if it is hidden.
trade.desktopNotificationTestBody: This is a test desktop notification.
trade.connected-apps-none-details: Apps you connect to Tealstreet will appear here.
trade.connected-apps-disconnect-failed: Could not disconnect that app. Please try again.
trade.connected-apps-load-failed: Could not load your connected apps.
trade.connected-apps-scope-modules-write: Create and edit your custom modules
trade.connected-apps-scope-dashboard-write: Create and update your MCP dashboard sessions and widgets
trade.connected-apps-scope-onchain-read: Read public onchain and address-keyed analytics
trade.settings-experimental-empty: No experimental features available at this time. Check back later for new features to test!
trade.cli-preferred-server-details: When a paired CLI server is selected, the web app will sync API keys and run certain long lived operations (like TWAP) through your own server.
trade.cli-local-server-running-content: The local server is managed by the desktop app. To stop it, uncheck Server → Local Server Mode in the menu bar.
trade.cli-sync-strategy-details: How to handle differences when syncing API keys between web and CLI.
trade.cli-sync-modal-warning: Your API keys differ between the web app and CLI server ({{instanceName}}). Please choose how to resolve.
trade.cli-sync-strategy-merge-hint: Accounts from both web and CLI will be combined. Conflicts use web version.
trade.cli-sync-strategy-web-hint: CLI accounts will be replaced with web accounts.
trade.cli-sync-strategy-cli-hint: Web accounts will be replaced with CLI accounts.
trade.cli-hosted-details: Connect to {{brand}}'s hosted server. Your API keys never leave your browser — the server only handles data streaming.
trade.hosted-server-reconnect-accounts: Reconnect accounts to the hosted server
trade.hosted-server-info: Connect to {{brand}}'s hosted server. Your API keys never leave your browser — the server only handles data streaming. Active accounts reconnect when you change this.
trade.hosted-server-switch-failed: Could not reconnect your accounts after switching the hosted server
trade.cli-local-server-auto-start-details: Automatically start the local CLI server when the desktop app launches.
trade.enable-cross-trading-description: Allow trading across multiple exchanges simultaneously. This feature is experimental and may have bugs or unexpected behavior.
trade.show-cross-trade-module-description: Adds the Cross Trade module to the layout dropdown so you can mirror positions from one account to others.
trade.webhook-relay-url-details: Paste into a TradingView alert's Webhook URL. The alert's Message runs as CLI commands on the listener below. Treat this URL as a password.
trade.webhook-relay-browser-off: Off. Turn on to make this browser a listener you can choose below.
trade.webhook-relay-browser-standby: Connected, but another listener runs your webhooks.
trade.webhook-relay-browser-waiting: Not listening yet: waiting for sign-in and your accounts to load, or another tab of this browser is the listener.
trade.webhook-relay-browser-signed-out: Your sign-in expired. Sign in again to receive webhooks here.
trade.webhook-relay-no-listeners: No listeners yet. Start the CLI while logged in, or turn on Receive webhooks in this browser, then choose it below.
trade.webhook-relay-none-claimed: No listener runs your webhooks: alerts expire unrun until you choose one.
trade.webhook-relay-hold-details: How long an alert waits for the listener to come back before it expires without running.
trade.webhook-relay-release-details: Stop every listener from running your webhooks.
trade.webhook-relay-action-failed: That did not save. Try again.
trade.asterdex-wallet-address-case-sensitive-h: For Aster API Wallet/vault keys, enter your login wallet in Main Wallet Address and the API Wallet/vault address in API Wallet / Vault Address. Do not replace the main wallet with the API wallet. Both addresses are case sensitive.
trade.paradex-subkey-address-helper: Subkey Address: your Paradex subkey address for delegated trading.
trade.paradex-subkey-private-key-helper: Subkey Private Key: used to derive your Paradex account.
trade.paradex-address-helper: Paradex Address: your Paradex account address on Starknet.
trade.bybit-demo-separate-keys-helper: Demo uses its own API keys. Create the key inside your Bybit demo account. A mainnet key will not work in Demo, and a demo key will not work in the other modes. Switching between Demo and the other modes clears the key fields, so enter the key for whichever mode you end on.
trade.grvt-builder-wallet-helper: GRVT builder fee approval must be signed by the wallet that owns your GRVT main/funding account. If you signed up to GRVT with email or social login, GRVT may control an embedded wallet that cannot sign this approval in Tealstreet.
trade.hyrotrader-challenge-keys-helper: Copy the challenge API key and secret from your HyroTrader dashboard for this challenge. The shared HyroTrader demo account uses Tealstreet-managed demo credentials, so only paste your own keys for a real challenge account.
trade.vault-field-rule-message: Please input the vault or sub-account address
trade.account-name-field-rule-message2: Account name cannot by a different exchange name
trade.account-color-field-rule-message: Please input your account color tag
trade.vault-optional-helper: Optional: for Hyperliquid sub-accounts or vaults, enter the sub-account or vault address here. Do not enter a private key.
trade.vault-placeholder: Optional sub-account or vault address (not a private key)
trade.api-key-index-field-rule-message: Please input your API key index
trade.api-key-index-helper: The index of the API key you created. Lighter recommends using an indice of 4 or higher.
trade.stark-private-key-field-rule-message: Please input your Stark private key
trade.omni-key-seed-field-rule-message: Please input your Omni key seed
trade.margin-effective-leverage-tooltip: Portfolio exposure divided by account equity for cross margin. Isolated margin modes show 0.00x here.
trade.lighter-account-tier-tooltip: Lighter account tiers affect fees, order latency, and rate limits. Lighter official competitions may require Premium or Plus accounts.
trade.lighter-account-tier-setting-details: Changes the Lighter tier of the L1 address for this key. Lighter allows one tier change every 24 hours & requires no open orders/positions. Fees, Latency, & Rate Limits vary by tier.
trade.lighter-robinhood-usdg-helper: Robinhood Chain Lighter uses separate account indexes and API keys from zkLighter. Perps are margined in USDG.
trade.lighter-stop-slippage-tooltip: Allowed execution slippage for Lighter stop-loss and take-profit orders. Lighter uses the order price as the worst acceptable execution price after the trigger, so higher values improve fill chance during fast moves but allow worse fills.
trade.lighter-change-account-tier-warning: Lighter requires no open orders or positions before changing tiers. You can only change account tier once every 24 hours.
trade.lighter-change-account-tier-fee-warning: Premium and Plus tiers can change Lighter maker/taker fees, latency, and rate limits. Plus is API-only and may require Lighter Discord support/IP setup for full rate-limit benefits.
trade.bots-not-enabled: Trading bots are not enabled for your account.
trade.bots-no-linked-keys: No API keys are linked to bots yet.
trade.bots-none-on-account: No bots on this account yet.
trade.bots-unmatched: Not matched to a linked key
trade.bots-select: Select a bot to see its grid.
trade.bots-control-stop-done: Bot stopped. Any open position stays open.
trade.bots-control-close-body: The position is closed at market. The bot keeps running unless you stop it too.
trade.bots-create-out-trigger-hint: How far from an entry its exit is placed. Required.
trade.bots-create-confirm-body: It will trade {{symbol}} ({{kind}}) on this account, {{side}}, between {{bottom}} and {{top}}, with real funds.
trade.bots-create-confirm-range: The range should contain the current price. A grid entirely above or below it fills immediately.
trade.bots-create-confirm-no-stop: No stop loss is set. The bot will keep trading through a move against it.
trade.bots-edit-failed: Could not read this bot's settings.
trade.bots-edit-market-fixed: Fixed when the bot was created
trade.bots-edit-confirm-body: They replace the bot's current settings on {{symbol}}.
trade.bots-edit-confirm-running: This bot is running. Saving replaces the settings it is trading on; what happens to orders it has already placed is not something we can promise.
trade.hotkey-click-to-trade-description: Hold and click to place limit order at price on Chart, Depth Chart or Orderbook (buy if below price, sell if above)
trade.hotkey-click-to-buy-description: Hold and click price on Chart, Depth Chart or Orderbook to place limit buy
trade.hotkey-click-to-sell-description: Hold and click price on Chart, Depth Chart or Orderbook to place limit sell
trade.hotkey-click-to-stop-label: Place Stop Loss at Clicked Price
trade.hotkey-click-to-stop-description: Hold and click to place a Stop Loss, Market, Close on Trigger order totaling your current position size + resting limits
trade.hotkey-click-to-tp-label: Place Take Profit at Clicked Price
trade.hotkey-click-to-tp-description: Hold and click to place a Take Profit, Market, Close on Trigger order totaling your current position size + resting limits
trade.market-buy-description: Submits Market buy order using size in order module
trade.market-sell-description: Submits Market sell order using size in order module
trade.only-supported-in-app: Only supported in the {{brand}} Desktop App.
trade.place-buy-description: Place a buy order at the current price in the Place Order module. If scaled buy preview is active, submits scaled buy
trade.place-sell-description: Place a sell order at the current price in the Place Order module. If scaled sell preview is active, submits scaled sell
trade.cancel-top-listed-order-description: Cancel most recent order. If scaled preview is active, cancels scaled preview
trade.cancel-buys-description: Cancel resting buy orders for active market
trade.cancel-sells-description: Cancel resting sell orders for active market
trade.cancel-active-description: Cancel resting orders for active market
trade.cancel-all-description: Cancel all orders for all markets across all active accounts
trade.chase-ask-description: Chase the ask side of the orderbook
trade.chase-bid-description: Chase the bid side of the orderbook
trade.buy-at-top-orderbook-description: Place buy order at the top buy side of Orderbook
trade.sell-at-top-orderbook-description: Place sell order at the top sell side of Orderbook
trade.buy-at-mid-bid-orderbook-description: Place a buy order on bid side at offset from the top of the book
trade.sell-at-mid-ask-orderbook-description: Place a sell order on ask side at offset from the top of the book
trade.sell-at-bottom-orderbook-description: Place a sell order at the 3rd level shown on Orderbook (adjusted for grouping).
trade.set-price-from-chart-description: Hold and click Chart to auto populate the price in the Place Order module
trade.click-to-bracket-description: Hold and click to preview bracket order with entry at clicked price
trade.toggle-track-price-description: Toggle the track price checkbox in the Place Order module
trade.toggle-post-only-description: Toggle the post only checkbox in the Place Order module
trade.toggle-reduce-description: Toggle the reduce checkbox in the Place Order module
trade.place-scaled-order-description: Hold and click twice on chart to set scaled order between prices
trade.close-top-listed-description: Close the top listed position in the positions table.
trade.flatten-positions-description: Close all open positions with reduce market orders
trade.market-close-active-position-description: Close the currently active symbol with a market order
trade.limit-close-active-position-description: Place a reduce-only limit order at near-touch to close the active position
trade.chase-close-active-position-description: Start a chaser reduce-only order to close the active position
trade.move-track-price-farther-description: Move track price offset on both sides farther from top of book
trade.move-track-price-closer-description: Move track price offset on both sides closer to top book prices
trade.modify-single-scaled-order-description: Hold to modify single scaled order in Chart preview
trade.bulk-drag-scaled-orders-description: Hold to move all scaled order evenly in preview.
trade.search-chart-symbol-description: Directly open the TradingView symbol search prompt (avoid clicking or hitting other shortcuts).
trade.auto-populate-position-size-description: Auto populates active market open position size in the Limit order form.
trade.toggle-place-order-chart-overlay-descrip: Toggle the place order chart overlay in multi chart trading.
trade.drag-to-duplicate-description: Hold and move an order on chart to duplicate target order.
trade.toggle-place-order-overlay-description: Toggle the place order module as an overlay on top of the terminal. Click on a module to bind focus
trade.bybit-insufficient-balance-new-leverage: Bybit rejected this leverage change because your account does not have enough available balance to support the new margin requirement. Free up balance, reduce the position, or choose a leverage that requires less margin.
trade.cannot-place-order-missing-last-price-da: Cannot place order without a last price data
trade.cannot-place-order-missing-mark-price-da: Cannot place order without a mark price data
trade.cannot-place-order-size-too-small: Cannot place order, size too small. Ensure that the Order Form Size is set correctly.
trade.track-price-controlling-input: Track price is controlling this input. Turn Track off to set the price manually.
trade.no-order-partials-for-preview: No order partials found while previewing...
trade.scaled-price-lower-or-price-upper-is-req: Lower Price or Upper Price is required
trade.scaled-total-size-too-small-for-order-co: Total size too small for order count
trade.order-size-must-be-greater-than-zero: Order size must be greater than zero
trade.chaser-order-not-supported-exchanges: Some exchanges may not support Chase Orders
trade.chaser-browser-close-protection-details: Shows a confirmation dialog when you try to close your browser while chase orders are active
trade.order-tabs-uncollapsed: Show All Order Tabs (otherwise e. g. Market & Quick orders are collapsed in Tabs)
trade.quote-size-requires-price: Set a valid price before sizing in quote currency.
trade.EC_ClOrdIDOrigClOrdIDAreTheSame: Client Order ID and Original Client Order ID are the same
trade.EC_OrigClOrdIDDoesNotExist: Original Client Order ID does not exist
trade.EC_MarketOrderPriceIsNotZero: Market Order Price is not zero
trade.EC_LimitOrderInvalidPrice: Invalid price for a limit order
trade.EC_MarketOrderCannotBePostOnly: Market order cannot be Post Only
trade.EC_PostOnlyWillTakeLiquidity: Cannot execute a taker order as Post Only
trade.custom-button-sizes-per-symbol-desc: Set different button sizes for specific trading pairs. For example, use larger sizes for ETH pairs.
trade.no-custom-button-sizes: No custom button sizes configured. Add a symbol to get started.
trade.chaser-tick-delay: Chaser Order ticks delay in seconds
trade.use-tealstreet-ws-route-description: Use {{brand}}'s optimized WebSocket routing for better performance and reliability
trade.enable-spot-markets-description: Add this exchange's spot markets to the same connection, so you don't need a separate account for spot. Leave off if you only trade perps — it keeps your market list and data usage unchanged.
trade.market-type-perps-spot-description: Trade both perpetual futures and spot markets
trade.use-extension-direct-description: Connect this account straight to the exchange from your browser using the {{brand}} extension, bypassing the proxy. Requires the extension to be installed.
trade.bybit-brazil-account-description: Sends x-site-id: BRA_BTL on Bybit requests, as required for Bybit Brazil accounts.
trade.bybit-brazil-ws-advisory: REST requests will include the Bybit Brazil header. Direct browser WebSocket connections may not carry it until the tunnel route ships, so some realtime updates can be limited while REST fallback keeps account state available.
trade.ip-whitelist-required: In order to use {{brand}} Network (this exchange requires CORS-proxy to operate), following IPs should be whitelisted for API key:
trade.ip-whitelist-recommended: To enhance security of your API key, it is recommended to whitelist only these IPs:
trade.okxeudemo-ip-whitelist-direct-ws: OKX EU Demo REST requests use Tealstreet proxy IPs, but private WebSockets connect directly from your browser. If you restrict this API key by IP, also whitelist your current public IP or VPN egress IP.
trade.showUnrealisedPnlSwitchLabel: Show Unrealised PnL on Order Label
trade.showRealisedPnlSwitchLabel: Show Realised PnL on Order Label
trade.crosshairPnlDisplayModeDescription: Split shows cumulative realized PnL plus remaining-position UPnL. Total shows their sum.
trade.partialTPSLSwitchLabelDetails: Drag the TP/SL slider horizontally to adjust TPSL amount from 0% to 100%.
trade.infinityTPSLSwitchLabelDetails: Place Full TP/SL to always close entire position
trade.useLimitForPositionTPSwitchLabelDetails: When enabled the TP slider will place a Limit Reduce order instead of a Trigger TP order
trade.partialTPSLPercentsDetails: Customize the five size percentages used by the draggable partial TP/SL slider.
trade.syncGlobalSymbolOnClickSwitchDescription: If you are trading using chart split view, you MUST have this enabled to be able to switch symbol on focus
trade.showBracketOnPositions: Show TP/SL Slider on Position Label
trade.showBracketOnOrders: Show TP/SL Slider on Order Label
trade.bracket-drag-hint: Drag the TP button up or down to set a Take Profit order
trade.bracket-drag-hint-sl: Drag the SL button up or down to set a Stop Loss order
trade.custom-pinejs-study-delete-content: Delete this local study? This cannot be undone.
trade.custom-pinejs-study-editor-crashed: The editor crashed while analyzing this code. Close and reopen the editor, then paste a smaller or valid JavaScript study.
trade.custom-pinejs-study-script-warning: Local study code runs in this browser page and can access page data or freeze charts. Only save code you trust.
trade.chartAiAnalysisDetails: Shows Analyze chart and Select pattern on the chart while you hover it, and lets the Agent read the chart. Needs the Agent and the command bar. Off: no buttons and no chart analysis.
trade.chartContextMenuActions-details: Choose which Tealstreet trading actions appear in the chart right-click menu. On hosted TradingView and Tealchart, disabling every action removes the right-click menu entirely.
trade.showExchangeWarningsAsErrors: Show All Exchange Failure Events as Errors
trade.hotkey-focus-command-bar-description: Jump to the command bar in the header. Works even when trading hotkeys are off. While unbound, / is used if no other hotkey has it.
trade.hotkey-toggle-activity-panel-description: Show or hide the activity panel beside the grid, while the command bar is on. Works even when trading hotkeys are off, except while the chart has focus. While unbound, ` (the key left of 1 on a US keyboard) is used if no other hotkey has it.
trade.journal-account-label-hint: A friendly name to identify this account
trade.journal-hyperliquid-wallet-hint: Your Hyperliquid wallet address (0x...). No private key needed for read-only.
trade.journal-hyperliquid-permissions: No API key needed. Just your public wallet address.
trade.journal-add-first-account: Add your first account to start tracking your trades
trade.sharePositionDataDetails: Anonymously share your position data to contribute to community alerts. Your data is hashed and cannot be traced back to you.
trade.receivePositionAlertsDetails: Get notified when large combined positions are opened by other users.
trade.receivePositionAlertsDisabledDetails: Enable 'Share Position Data' first to receive alerts from others.
trade.pending-chaser-position: Position pending - Chaser is attempting to place initial order

cli.webTab: In-browser CLI — runs in this tab, no install needed
cli.listenerTab: Dispatch commands to the locally-running {{brand}} CLI
cli.listenerStatusPairingTooltip: Approve the connection on the CLI
cli.listenerStatusRejectedTooltip: CLI rejected this client. Use the CLI's `clients` command to re-approve.
cli.listenerStatusChangedTooltip: Local CLI identity changed. Re-approve via the modal.

trade.contract-type-lin-tooltip: Linear perpetual contract. Margin and PnL are in quote currency.
trade.contract-type-inv-tooltip: Inverse perpetual contract. Margin and PnL are in base currency.
trade.hotkeys-disabled-warning-desc: Toggle the switch to enable hotkeys.
trade.settings-use-larger-recv-window: Use larger RECV_WINDOW for Binance (helps on slow connection, requires refresh)
trade.force-logout-description: Use this if you're stuck in a broken auth state (logged in but no user data)
trade.volume-bars-color-overrides: Volume bars color overrides will be applied next chat refresh.
trade.trading-view-enable-theming: Enable Main Chart TradingView Theming (Needs Reload)
trade.custom-css-info: CSS is saved per theme and will be exported with your theme. Changes are applied automatically.
trade.name: Name
trade.enable-kline-popover-charts: Hover Over Symbol for Popover Chart
trade.phoenix-news-retrieve: Retrieve from: https://phoenixnews.io/, Account, Copy ApiKey
trade.reverse-quick-actions-tooltip: Due to the Hedge Mode, reverse will be executed in two orders (reduceOnly & non-reduceOnly) with a delay of 500ms
trade.display-buttons-in-single-line: Quick Order Buttons in Single Line
trade.pleaseActivateAccount: Please activate an account via top menu bar
trade.pleaseActivateLinkedAccount: Please activate linked account via top menu bar to unlink this module
trade.tapToUnlinkInactiveAccount: Tap to unlink this module from the inactive account
trade.secondary-key-banner-block-title: Action required: add a read-only key
trade.secondary-key-banner-description: Add a secondary read-only API key so your market data routes separately and stays fast.
trade.reconnect-cli-backend-tooltip: Reconnect to CLI backend and restart exchange workers
trade.dontAutoReconnectIfWindowHidden: Disable Auto-Reconnect When Window is Hidden
trade.dontAutoReconnectIfWindowHiddenDescripti: Prevents automatic reconnection attempts when the browser window/tab is not visible
trade.skipRendersWhenWindowIsHidden: Skip Renders When Window is Hidden
trade.skipRendersWhenWindowIsHiddenDescription: Stops rendering updates when the browser window/tab is not visible
trade.throttleWorkerUpdatesWhenHiddenDescripti: Heavily throttle exchange data updates when the window is hidden. Reduces bandwidth and CPU usage but may cause brief data staleness when returning to the app.
trade.disableNewsFeedsDescription: Disable all news feed WebSocket connections (Tree of Alpha, Phoenix News, etc)
trade.extraRendersWarning: Unlikely to increase core performance, but may increase peripheral update speeds
trade.qr-code-sync-instruction: In the Tealstreet mobile app, tap Add an API key and choose Scan QR Code from Web, then point your camera at this code.
trade.qr-code-contains-secret: This code contains your API keys and private keys. Only scan it with your own device.
trade.qr-code-too-large: This account has too much data for a QR code. Use the row's Copy button, then Add an API key → Paste from Clipboard on the other device.
trade.scaled-tpsl-description: Create multiple TP/SL orders distributed across a price range
trade.move-quick-margin-slider-to-bottom: Move Quick Margin Slider to Bottom
trade.move-quick-chaser-buttons-to-bottom: Move Quick Chaser Buttons to Bottom
trade.quick-buy-sell-columns-description: Group the Quick tab's order buttons by direction, buys in the left column (Offer Bid + Take Ask), sells in the right (Offer Ask + Take Bid), instead of by order type (offer column / take column). Post and reduce toggles follow the columns
trade.order-entry-tabs-last-visible: At least one Order Entry tab must stay visible
trade.order-entry-scale-description: Scales the Order Entry UI — font sizes, padding, buttons and inputs — up or down. 100% is default.
trade.dual-size-inputs-description: Show two or more size inputs per column, the base symbol on the left and the quote currency (USDT / USDC) on the right, instead of one input field with a unit dropdown
trade.single-column-order-form-auto-desc: Two columns, collapses to one when the panel is narrow
trade.single-column-order-form-single-desc: One column with shared Buy/Sell inputs, both buttons kept
trade.scaled-total-rounded: Total size was rounded due to exchange amount precision requirements.
trade.stop-loss-exceeds-drawdown: Warning: Stop loss would result in {{loss}} USD loss, exceeding your {{percent}}% max drawdown ({{max}} USD)
trade.drag-to-reorder-click-to-toggle: Drag to reorder • Click to toggle visibility
trade.starkPrivateKey: Stark Private Key (will be verified on first order created)
trade.apex-trigger-type-note: * ApeX TP/SL on Limit always have Index trigger type
trade.breakout-account-id-help: 5 digit account ID listed under Login on the credentials page or Accounts on the profile table. If you only have a single active Breakout account you can omit this field.
trade.lock-tpsl-percent-tooltip: When on, the typed TP/SL % is locked and the absolute prices update as the entry moves. When off, the prices stay frozen at the initial derive and the % is recalculated from price + entry.
trade.referral-banner-description: Click to register now and support the referrer!
trade.enable-show-order-details: Show Order Details Below Order Buttons
trade.enable-preview-tpsl-and-risk-tools: Enable TP/SL Preview and Risk Tools
trade.recommended-best-available-route: Using Websocket instead of HTTP is a recommended setting as it will exclude impact of hand-shakes performing exchange data requests
trade.openPositionsShowShortSymbolMobile: Show Short Symbol Name on Mobile
trade.openPositionsUseTwoRowsLayoutMobile: Use two rows layout on Mobile
trade.openPositionsHideUpnlPercentMobile: Hide % in UPnL column on Mobile
trade.disableVirtualizedTablesDescription: Might fix UI lagginess issues when a lot of orders/positions are displayed depending on your system
trade.monoDigitsDescription: Use monospace font for numbers in tables, orderbook, and price displays for better column alignment
trade.marketplaceUsernameDetails: Shown in Chat, Marketplace listings, and future public/social features
trade.marketplaceUsernameTaken: This account name is already taken
trade.marketplaceUsernameLoadFailed: Failed to load public account name
trade.marketplaceUsernameSaveFailed: Failed to save public account name
trade.cloud-storage-description: Your accounts will be encrypted with your passphrase before being stored in the cloud. The passphrase never leaves your browser.
trade.cloud-storage-passphrase-hint: Minimum 8 characters with letters and numbers
trade.cloud-storage-warning-1: Your passphrase is not stored anywhere - if you forget it, your data cannot be recovered
trade.cloud-storage-warning-2: Use a strong, unique passphrase that you will remember
trade.cloud-storage-warning-3: Data is encrypted locally before being sent to the cloud

trade.phoenix-news-api-key-description: Retrieve from phoenixnews.io, under Account, Copy ApiKey.
trade.highlights-description: Words to colour wherever they appear in a post. Separate several with commas.
trade.customSymbolKeywordPairs-description: Map a symbol to the words that should surface it, so a post naming the word offers that market.
trade.reconnectOnVisibleDescription: Reload account data when you come back to the app after a short absence. A long one always reconnects.
trade.performance-throttling-description: Lower values ask the server for less data. Changing this reloads your accounts.
trade.account-name-already-exists: An account with this name already exists
trade.mobile-unsupported-exchanges-imported: {{exchanges}} accounts were imported but will not connect on mobile.
trade.notifications-this-phone-details: Allow notifications so price alerts and news can reach this phone.
trade.notifications-no-devices: No devices yet. Turn on notifications on this phone to add it.
trade.notifications-test-too-soon: Wait a few seconds before sending another test.
trade.notifications-news-details: A news item must match every condition you set; any entry in a list counts. Impact and confidence only match items that were scored.
trade.notifications-per-minute-details: 1 to 60. Past this, notifications are held and one summary is sent.
trade.notifications-load-failed: Couldn't load your notification settings. Check your connection and try again.
trade.notifications-register-failed: Couldn't register this phone for notifications. Try again.
trade.notifications-not-registered: Allowed, but this phone isn't registered yet. Turn this on to try again.
trade.browser-view-no-bookmarks: No bookmarks. Add one below, or restore the defaults.
trade.browser-view-invalid-url: Enter a web address, like openmarket.xyz.
trade.affiliate-page-not-on-programme: You are not on the affiliate programme. If you think that is wrong, talk to us — a rate has to be set against your code before anything appears here.
trade.affiliate-page-footnote: Volume counts everything your referred users have routed through {{brand}}, with no start date. Earnings only begin once a rate was set for you, and are calculated from the rate in force at each individual fill — so changing your rate never restates what you already earned. Has traded is how many of your referrals have a trade recorded here. Trades appear once the venue publishes them — the line above says how far that is — and only from a venue account your referral has linked. If you have sub-affiliates, Earnings includes your share of what they earn, so a day can show payout with no volume of your own.
trade.affiliate-page-link-explainer: Anyone who signs up through this link is credited to you, on every venue, permanently.
trade.affiliate-page-history-failed: Could not load your history. Reload the page to try again.
trade.affiliate-page-chart-empty: Nothing to chart yet. Volume appears once one of your referrals links a venue account, and payout once a rate is set for you.
trade.affiliate-page-tier-multiple-codes: You hold more than one rated affiliate code, so we will not guess which one to reprice. Talk to us and we will set it.
trade.affiliate-page-tier-explainer: This is the Hyperliquid builder fee charged to people who sign up with {{code}} — they pay it, not you, and your rate is a percentage of it. It applies to referrals who have not been assigned a fee yet; anyone already assigned keeps what they approved, permanently. Referrals who were already approved at 0.01% before you chose stay there too.
trade.affiliate-page-tier-too-soon: You changed this a moment ago. Try again shortly.
trade.affiliate-page-tier-save-failed: That did not save. Try again, or talk to us.

module-draft-uncommitted: A connected app has uncommitted changes to this module. They are not live on any device until it commits them.
